rows.abstract: Proposes that an individual's blood type must be duly certified by a pathologist to guarantee its accuracy.  Seeks to identify government-issued documents that shall bear the blood type of an individual as follows:  ID issued by the SSS/GSIS; passport issued by the DFA; professional ID card issued by the PRC; birth certificate issued by the Local Registrar's Office or the PSA; driver's license issued by the LTO; firearms license issued by the PNP; and such other issuance of certificates, license or ID document after the effectivity of this Act

rows.author: K091;
rows.title_full:
AN ACT INCORPORATING THE VALUE OF RESPONSIBLE, FAIR USAGE, AND
ENJOYMENT OF SOCIAL MEDIA IN EDUCATION CURRICULA NATIONWIDE, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to include social media in the curricula for primary and secondary education - to instill onto the youth and for students the virtues of discernment and critical thinking in their unavoidable daily immersion therein.

Aims to specifically aid in the effective and efficient dissemination of information; help in shaping public discourse and opinion; help in fostering a more participative democracy; instill the importance of upholding truth and the veracity of facts, figures, and events therein; . . . etc.

Proposes to include Social Media Awareness as part of the National Service Training Program (NSTP) - Literacy Training Service and Civic Welfare Training Service (CWTS).
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2022-09-12

rows.author: J026;J118;K101;K103;
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2024-11-19, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-11-21 and received by the Senate on 2024-11-21
rows.title_full:
AN ACT PROVIDING FOR PROTECTION OF THE REMITTANCES OF OVERSEAS
FILIPINO WORKERS
rows.abstract:
Seeks to protect the rights and interests of OFWs regarding their foreign funds transfers.  Proposes that bank and non-bank financial intermediaries providing discounts on remittance fees shall be granted tax deduction based on the cost of services they rendered to OFWs.

Proposes to protect OFWs foreign exchange remittances against usurious interest rates and exorbitant fees.  Requires that OFWs and their families undergo education and training in financial literacy such as financial planning and managing finances or savings.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10959
